title: Run through a quantified-formula node
statement: For any bit string $x$ and natural numbers $k,S,p,B$ satisfying $2k\le B$, $S\le B$, and $p\le B$, the seven-register program with its specified oracle has a run from the node label with depth $k$, stack value $S$, pointer $p$, and all scratch registers zero to the label $\mathrm{nd1}$ with depth $k$, stack value $S$, pointer $2k$, and all scratch registers zero. Every configuration before the final configuration satisfies the program precondition and has every register value at most $B$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string, $B,k,S,p$ natural numbers, and suppose $2k\leq B$, $S\leq B$,
and $p\leq B$. Then the machine has a guarded run from the node state with depth $k$,
assignment stack $S$, and pointer $p$ (all scratch registers zero) to state
$\mathrm{nd1}$ with depth $k$, assignment stack $S$, pointer $2k$, and all scratch
registers zero.
